subject: Scientific Instruments Change - Eastern Shore
text:
Scientific Instruments Change - Eastern Shore
Subsurface scientific mooring 97 meters in length deployed in 174 meters depth with top of mooring 52 meter below surface.  The mooring is equipped with a profiling communications float that surfaces every 4 hours to transmit data and then retract down to 52 meters depth during surfacing intervals. 
A wide berth is requested.
